name: Investigate the Scourge of Orgrimmar
summary: Outside Orgrimmar, the Scourge has raised a camp beneath a floating necropolis. Lieutenant Dagel calls on defenders to repel the undead, recover necrotic stones, and examine runic circles charged with necromantic energy. The attack brings the Lich King's reach to Durotar.

sections.title: Undead at the Gates
sections.body: The Scourge now threatens lands far from Lordaeron and the northern ice. Floating necropolises cast their shadows across Azeroth, even over Durotar. Undead forces have gathered at Orgrimmar's threshold, raising camps that threaten the Horde capital. Lieutenant Dagel and the Argent Dawn coordinate the defense, calling on local champions to drive the invaders back before they can secure a siege.

sections.title: Necrotic Relics and Dark Whispers
sections.body: The Scourge's camp holds dim necrotic stones and glowing runic circles. The circles ring the camp and carry the same dark power as the necropolis above. Those who step into the runes hear unnatural voices echoing through the ether. The voices suggest some kind of communication, though Dagel does not know whom they reach.

faq.q: Why is the Scourge attacking Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Scourge forces have camped outside Orgrimmar beneath a necropolis. Lieutenant Dagel asks defenders to thin their ranks and investigate the nearby runic circles.

Lieutenant Dagel is an officer coordinating with the Argent Dawn to rally defenders against the invasion. From near the threat, Dagel directs fighters to slay the undead and examine their arcane tools.

faq.q: What are the dim necrotic stones?
faq.answer: Dim necrotic stones are taken from Scourge invaders and brought to the Argent Dawn as proof that undead have been slain.

faq.q: What are the glowing runic circles outside the city?
faq.answer: The glowing circles hold the same strange energy as the nearby undead and necropolis. Dagel asks defenders to investigate their purpose.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn involved in Durotar?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn is an independent order devoted to destroying the Scourge wherever it appears. The order works with Horde defenders to protect Orgrimmar's borders from the invasion.

faq.q: Is the necropolis overhead dangerous to the city?
faq.answer: The necropolis looms over the Scourge camp and shares its strange energy. Its presence makes the undead threat near the city a concern.

angles.text: A Scourge force camped within sight of Orgrimmar's towers is an insult the Horde cannot bear. Every sworn champion has a duty to defend Durotar from the Lich King's minions.
Orcs won Durotar's dry red soil through hardship and blood. They will not let mindless monstrosities blight the home they carved out with their bare hands.
For the Forsaken, the Scourge recalls their former enslavement. Crushing the invaders is a personal vendetta against the Lich King's continuing reach.
